channel.title: Wahaj Ayub - Research Radar
channel.description: Selected papers in topological photovoltaics, quantum geometry, noncentrosymmetric materials, Hopf phases, and mathematical condensed matter.

item.title: Multi-State Geometry of Density Matrices and Rectification Sum Rules
item.description: A many-body multi-state geometry yields rectification sum rules that generalize shift-current geometry beyond clean, noninteracting systems.

item.title: Large nonlinear Hall effect in strained moiré structures hosting high-pseudospin fermions
item.description: Strain activates a Berry-curvature-dipole nonlinear Hall response in a moiré lattice whose sign changes across high-Chern topological phase boundaries.

item.title: Flexoelectric Suppression of Interfacial Carrier Loss in BaTiO 3 Thin‐Film Bulk Photovoltaic Systems
item.description: Flexoelectric strain gradients enhance BaTiO3 thin-film photocurrent by reshaping interfacial electrostatics and suppressing carrier recombination.

item.title: Topological Charge-Transfer Excitons
item.description: Bond-centered charge-transfer excitons form a topological Kagome-like band with nearly uniform quantum geometry even when the underlying electron and hole bands are trivial.

item.title: Optical signatures and quantum geometry in proximity-induced topological superconductors
item.description: Thickness-extracted optical conductance isolates a buried proximitized interface and relates its low-frequency spectral weight to quantum geometry.

item.title: Helical-to-Fan Transitions under Magnetic Fields in the Noncentrosymmetric Tetragonal Magnet EuRhGe$_3$
item.description: Resonant x-ray diffraction maps field-driven helical, soliton-lattice, and fan phases in the explicitly noncentrosymmetric magnet EuRhGe3.
